title: High Pressure Lockout
fullDescription: Bryant AC reports E1 when the high pressure safety switch trips. Bryant shares its platform with Carrier — diagnostics and parts overlap.

fixSteps.title: Verify Fan
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm outdoor fan spins under load.

whenToCallPro: If coil and fan are good, refrigerant charge needs pro check.

faq.a: Same parts company; nearly identical systems.

safetyWarning: Capacitors retain lethal voltage; discharge before touching.

title: Indoor Anti-Freeze Protection
fullDescription: E2 trips when the indoor coil temperature is too low — system shuts down to prevent ice damage.

title: Low Pressure Lockout
fullDescription: E3 indicates low-side pressure dropped below safe limit — usually a refrigerant leak.

title: Compressor Overcurrent
fullDescription: E4 trips when current sensing detects compressor amp draw above its rated max.

title: Compressor Lockout
fullDescription: E5 is a safety lockout — Bryant board saw too many compressor faults in 24 hours.

title: Outdoor Fan Fault
fullDescription: E6 indicates the outdoor fan is not running.

faq.a: High pressure trips when fan stops.

title: Indoor Coil Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F0 indicates the indoor coil temperature sensor is open or shorted.
whenToCallPro: If sensor OK, indoor board suspect.

faq.a: Yes, but coil could freeze without protection.

title: Indoor EEPROM Error
fullDescription: P1 means the indoor control board can't read its config EEPROM.

title: Outdoor Comm Loss
fullDescription: U1 indicates the indoor unit cannot reach the outdoor unit over the comm bus.

title: Indoor Blower Fault
shortDescription: Blower not running at commanded speed.
fullDescription: H6 fires when the ECM indoor blower fails to reach commanded RPM.
